annotations.title: Which denominator produces this denial rate (2025)

description: ANSWERS: "an article says the FHA denial rate is 12.8%, what is that measured over", "why do two sources give different VA denial rates", "which definition gives 10.6%". Takes a 2025 denial rate someone quoted and returns every cell of the published denominator map that reproduces it: program (FHA or VA) x loan purpose (purchase, refinance, cash-out, all) x scope (all rows, or first-lien owner-occupied site-built 1-4 unit) x base (decisioned; all applications acted on; denied plus originated), with the denial and denominator counts behind each. A match shows which definition CAN produce the number from the 2025 HMDA file, not which one the publisher used. No match means another year, another filter, or a figure this file does not reproduce. Aggregates only; nothing here describes one applicant.

program.description: Optional: search one program only. Omit to search both.

rate_pct.description: The quoted denial rate in percent, e.g. 12.8

tolerance.description: Optional: how close a cell must be, in percentage points (default 0.15, maximum 0.5)
